statistic: true-support minimum normalised SSE (whitened SSE / entries) over the 27 nuisance members, per eligible calibration episode
seeds: java.util.SplittableRandom seeds 0x465043414C000000 + i for i = 0..103 (own calibration namespace FPCAL; never the SC1-SC3 seeds)
domain: support uniform over the 6 singles and 15 pairs; wind from U(240, 300) deg at U(2, 5) m/s; SO2 log-uniform 0.25 to 50 g/s per source (0.5 to 100 x nominal), CO2 = SO2 x 1000 x log-uniform(0.5, 2); nodes N1-N4 with 6 windows each per gas, and in half the episodes one aerial window at (0,100,35) or (120,100,35); eligible only if some window is above its floor
generator: 1 Hz quasi-steady plume under slow AR(1) wind drift around the reported wind (rho 0.995, direction sd 0.5 deg, speed sd 1%), AR(1) instrument noise and drifting common background from world-profile.json, minus a plume-free background window
